title: Bong Joon-ho Thematic Analysis - Class, Capitalism, and Monsters

class_struggle.core_conflict: Eternal battle between rich vs poor, haves vs have-nots

snowpiercer.metaphor: Train as microcosm of capitalist class division
snowpiercer.theme: Rich maintain power by keeping poor in place

parasite.bong_quote: Fear that gap won't be resolved in future
parasite.staircase_symbolism: Divisions of social class, power struggles
parasite.critique: System implicates everyone - poor want to become rich, not dismantle system

class_struggle.pattern: Sons from impoverished families become scapegoats (Memories, Mother)

capitalism_critique.approach: Sharp social commentary on failings of contemporary capitalism
capitalism_critique.parasite_insight: Class aspirationalism, political divide from economic disparity
capitalism_critique.upward_mobility_hostility: Desire to climb, contempt for those below
capitalism_critique.system_reproduction: Anti-capitalist narratives focusing on individual can reproduce capitalism's logic

monster_genre_subversion.purpose: Monster as metaphor for societal ills

the_host.literal_monster: Creature mutated by toxic waste (Han River formaldehyde)
the_host.real_monster: Hidden in mutated minds of those in power
the_host.critique: Government incompetence, arbitrary actions of powerful entities
the_host.family_focus: Resilience vs failure of official systems

okja.real_monster: Multi-national corporation, not the giant pig
okja.theme: Corporate capitalism's impact on individuals and environment

monster_genre_subversion.technique: Personify systemic problems within genre conventions
monster_genre_subversion.blend: Sci-fi horror + political satire + family drama
